To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method to generate a large number of stable, long-term, high-level expressing cell clones of ERα, in ERα-defective breast cancer cells.

(i) the yield of ERalpha expressing clones was increased by 10 fold, when using a bicistronic mRNA template, instead of a monocistronic template; (ii) the stability of ectopic ERalpha expression was improved in the bicistronic system; (iii) the yield of clones was further improved by increasing the number of transfecting plasmids; (iv) the yield of stable clones was further improved, by increasing the time interval between initial transfection and selection
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a synthetic lethaliy screening system in which the ERα gene is expressed ectopically, as part of a bicistronic transcript.
the generation of a synthetic lethalty screening system for breast cancer, using a cell line derived from the TN group, and ectopic expression of the ERα gene as part of a synthetic lethal system.
developing a system to study synthetic lethality in ERα− TN breast cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the IRES system is an efficient tool for obtaining ectopic expression, and that the IRES-ERα-hygroR bicistronic mRNA is an effective translation template for this purpose.

the use of bicistronic vectors, such as the pERα-Ires vector, may be a valuable strategy to overcome some of the difficulties associated with ectopic expression of certain genes in certain cell types.
the use of a bicistronic vector system for ectopic expression of a gene in an ERα-deficient cell line, is a viable and effective approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, when using the pERα-Ires bicistronic plasmid vector, it is possible to obtain high frequency of stable, ectopically expressed cell clones.
the IRES linkage system, in combination with an appropriate selection marker, may provide a very useful tool for generating stable cell clones with ectopic gene expression.

the use of bicistronic vectors, such as pERα-Ires, is a very effective tool to obtain stable, long-term, ectopic gene expression in cells, where the target gene is normally not expressed, or expressed at a very low level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bicistronic vector system can be used to circumvent some of the difficulties in establishing cell clones with ectopic expression of genes that are normally not expressed.
the use of a bicistronic mRNA template, with the IRES element placed between two ORFs, can greatly increase the efficiency of generating cell clones expressing ectopic protein.
the IRES vector linkage system is a very efficient tool for generating stable cell clones expressing the ectopic gene of interest.
